description: This file is a PHP source file defining the EmployeeActionSummaryDao class, which provides data access methods related to employee action summaries within a Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for retrieving counts of scheduled interviews, pending reviews, and self-reviews, utilizing internal query builders and external ORM entities.

classes.name: EmployeeActionSummaryDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for summarizing employee actions related to reviews and interviews within the HR system.

methods.name: getActionableScheduledInterviewCount
methods.description: Returns the count of scheduled interviews for a list of candidate IDs.

methods.name: getPendingAppraisalReviewCount
methods.description: Returns the count of pending appraisal reviews based on provided filters.

methods.name: getPendingAppraisalReviewQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Private method to build query for pending appraisal reviews with optional filtering by reviewer employee number.

methods.name: getActionableReviewQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Private method to build query for actionable reviews, including filters for employee status and review statuses.

methods.name: getPendingSelfReviewCount
methods.description: Returns the count of self-reviews pending for an employee based on filters.

methods.name: getSelfReviewQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Private method to build query for self-reviews for a specific employee.

methods.name: getPendingSelfReviewIds
methods.description: Private method to retrieve IDs of pending self-reviews for an employee.
